const (
	adminPrefix = ""
	apiPrefix   = "/api/v1"
)

func TestAdminCRUDPermissions(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	endpoints := []struct {
		name           string
		method         string
		path           string
		body           string
		expectedStatus int
	}{
		{
			name:           "create course",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/course/create",
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"slug":"course-auth","main_tech_id":%d}`, fixtures.mainTechID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusCreated,
		},
		{
			name:           "create module",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/module/create",
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Module","description":"desc"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusCreated,
		},
		{
			name:           "add course module",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/course-relations/add-module/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"module_id":"%s","order":1}`, fixtures.moduleID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusNoContent,
		},
		{
			name:           "create section",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/section/create",
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Section","description":"desc"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusCreated,
		},
		{
			name:           "add module section",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/module-relations/add-section/" + fixtures.moduleID,
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"section_id":"%s","order":1}`, fixtures.sectionID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusNoContent,
		},
		{
			name:           "create lesson",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/lesson/create",
			body:           fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Lesson","excerpt":"excerpt","description":"desc","versions":[{"tech_version_id":%d}],"compose_config":{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/lesson:latest"}}}}`, fixtures.techVersionID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusCreated,
		},
		{
			name:           "create task",
			method:         http.MethodPost,
			path:           adminPrefix + "/task/create",
			body:           createTaskBody(fixtures, fixtures.lessonID),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusCreated,
		},
		{
			name:           "update task",
			method:         http.MethodPut,
			path:           fmt.Sprintf("%s/task/update/%s", adminPrefix, fixtures.taskID),
			body:           updateTaskBody(fixtures),
			expectedStatus: http.StatusOK,
		},
	}

	allowedRoles := []string{"ADMIN", "MODERATOR"}
	for _, ep := range endpoints {
		for _, role := range allowedRoles {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s as %s", ep.name, role), func(t *testing.T) {
				resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, ep.method, ep.path, ep.body, role, "user-allowed")
				if resp.Code != ep.expectedStatus {
					t.Fatalf("expected %d for role %s on %s %s, got %d", ep.expectedStatus, role, ep.method, ep.path, resp.Code)
				}
			})
		}
	}

	forbiddenRoles := []string{"TEACHER", "STUDENT", "GUEST"}
	for _, ep := range endpoints {
		for _, role := range forbiddenRoles {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s forbidden for %s", ep.name, role), func(t *testing.T) {
				resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, ep.method, ep.path, ep.body, role, "user-forbidden")
				if resp.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
					t.Fatalf("expected 403 for role %s on %s %s, got %d", role, ep.method, ep.path, resp.Code)
				}
			})
		}
	}

	for _, ep := range endpoints {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s guest unauthorized", ep.name), func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, ep.method, ep.path, ep.body, "", "")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
				t.Fatalf("expected 401 for guest on %s %s, got %d", ep.method, ep.path, resp.Code)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAdminKebabCaseEndpoints(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	role := "ADMIN"
	userID := "admin-user"

	composeBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Compose","description":"desc","config":{"version":"3.9","services":{}},"tech_ids":[%d]}`, fixtures.mainTechID)
	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/compose-config/create", composeBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("expected 201 for compose-config create, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var composeCreate struct {
		ID string `json:"id"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &composeCreate); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if composeCreate.ID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected compose config id, got empty")
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/compose-config/list", "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for compose-config list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/compose-config/update/"+composeCreate.ID, `{"title":"Updated title"}`, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for compose-config update, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	moduleBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"visibility":%d,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Module","description":"Module desc"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth, fixtures.i18nID)
	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/module/create", moduleBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("expected 201 for module create, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var createdModule domain.Module
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &createdModule); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if createdModule.ID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected module id, got empty")
	}
	if createdModule.Visibility != domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth {
		t.Fatalf("expected module visibility %d, got %d", domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth, createdModule.Visibility)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/course-relations/add-module/"+fixtures.courseID, fmt.Sprintf(`{"module_id":"%s","order":2}`, createdModule.ID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for course module relation add, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/module/get/"+createdModule.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for module get, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var moduleGet struct {
		Module map[string]any `json:"module"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &moduleGet); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid module get json: %v", err)
	}
	if moduleGet.Module["title"] != "Module" {
		t.Fatalf("expected normalized module title, got %+v", moduleGet.Module)
	}
	if got := int(moduleGet.Module["visibility"].(float64)); got != domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth {
		t.Fatalf("expected normalized module visibility %d, got %d", domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth, got)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/module/list?course_id="+fixtures.courseID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for module list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/module/list?fields=id,title,visibility", "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for module compact list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var moduleList struct {
		Modules []map[string]any `json:"modules"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &moduleList); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid module list json: %v", err)
	}
	moduleTitleFound := false
	for _, item := range moduleList.Modules {
		if item["title"] == "Module" {
			moduleTitleFound = true
			if got := int(item["visibility"].(float64)); got != domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth {
				t.Fatalf("expected compact module visibility %d, got %d", domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth, got)
			}
			break
		}
	}
	if !moduleTitleFound {
		t.Fatalf("expected module title in compact list, got %+v", moduleList.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/module/update/"+createdModule.ID, fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"status":1,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Module 2","description":"Module desc 2"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for module update, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	sectionBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Section","description":"Section desc"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID)
	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/section/create", sectionBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("expected 201 for section create, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var createdSection domain.Section
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &createdSection); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if createdSection.ID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected section id, got empty")
	}
	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/section/list?fields=id,title", "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for section compact list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var sectionList struct {
		Sections []map[string]any `json:"sections"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &sectionList); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid section list json: %v", err)
	}
	sectionTitleFound := false
	for _, item := range sectionList.Sections {
		if item["title"] == "Section" {
			sectionTitleFound = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !sectionTitleFound {
		t.Fatalf("expected section title in compact list, got %+v", sectionList.Sections)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/module-relations/add-section/"+createdModule.ID, fmt.Sprintf(`{"section_id":"%s","order":2}`, createdSection.ID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for module section relation add, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/section/get/"+createdSection.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for section get, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/section/list?module_id="+createdModule.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for section list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/section/update/"+createdSection.ID, fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"status":1,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Section 2","description":"Section desc 2"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for section update, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	i18nBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"RU Title","description":"RU Desc"}`, fixtures.i18nID)
	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/course-i18n/create/"+fixtures.courseID, i18nBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("expected 201 for course-i18n create, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/course-i18n/list/"+fixtures.courseID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for course-i18n list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, fmt.Sprintf("%s/course-i18n/update/%s/%d", adminPrefix, fixtures.courseID, fixtures.i18nID), fmt.Sprintf(`{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"RU Title 2","description":"RU Desc 2"}`, fixtures.i18nID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for course-i18n update, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodDelete, fmt.Sprintf("%s/course-i18n/delete/%s/%d", adminPrefix, fixtures.courseID, fixtures.i18nID), "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for course-i18n delete, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/course-relations/update-tags/"+fixtures.courseID, `{"tag_ids":[]}`, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for course-relations update-tags, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/course-relations/update-techs/"+fixtures.courseID, `{"tech_ids":[]}`, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for course-relations update-techs, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodDelete, adminPrefix+"/section/delete/"+createdSection.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for section delete, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodDelete, adminPrefix+"/module/delete/"+createdModule.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for module delete, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodDelete, adminPrefix+"/compose-config/delete/"+composeCreate.ID, "", role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for compose-config delete, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
}

func TestCourseUpdateRequiresActiveLesson(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	role := "ADMIN"
	userID := "admin-user"

	updateCourseBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"slug":"existing-course","main_tech_id":%d,"status":%d}`, fixtures.mainTechID, domain.CourseStatusActive)
	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, adminPrefix+"/course/update/"+fixtures.courseID, updateCourseBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for course update with active lesson, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
}

func TestAdminKebabCaseEndpointsForbidden(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		method string
		path   string
		body   string
	}{
		{
			name:   "compose-config create",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/compose-config/create",
			body:   `{"title":"Compose","description":"desc","config":{"version":"3.9","services":{}}}`,
		},
		{
			name:   "module create",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/module/create",
			body:   fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d}`, fixtures.mainTechID),
		},
		{
			name:   "section create",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/section/create",
			body:   fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d}`, fixtures.mainTechID),
		},
		{
			name:   "course module relation add",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/course-relations/add-module/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body:   fmt.Sprintf(`{"module_id":"%s","order":1}`, fixtures.moduleID),
		},
		{
			name:   "module section relation add",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/module-relations/add-section/" + fixtures.moduleID,
			body:   fmt.Sprintf(`{"section_id":"%s","order":1}`, fixtures.sectionID),
		},
		{
			name:   "course-i18n create",
			method: http.MethodPost,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/course-i18n/create/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body:   fmt.Sprintf(`{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"RU Title","description":"RU Desc"}`, fixtures.i18nID),
		},
		{
			name:   "course-relations update tags",
			method: http.MethodPut,
			path:   adminPrefix + "/course-relations/update-tags/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body:   `{"tag_ids":[]}`,
		},
	}

	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name+" forbidden for student", func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, tc.method, tc.path, tc.body, "STUDENT", "user-forbidden")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
				t.Fatalf("expected 403 for student on %s %s, got %d", tc.method, tc.path, resp.Code)
			}
		})
		t.Run(tc.name+" guest unauthorized", func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, tc.method, tc.path, tc.body, "", "")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
				t.Fatalf("expected 401 for guest on %s %s, got %d", tc.method, tc.path, resp.Code)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCourseListPublic(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/course/list", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public course list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	var payload struct {
		Courses []map[string]any `json:"courses"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.Courses) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 course in list, got %d", len(payload.Courses))
	}
	if payload.Courses[0]["title"] != "Existing Title" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected title %q", payload.Courses[0]["title"])
	}
}

func TestModuleAndSectionListPublic(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public independent module list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var independentPayload struct {
		Modules []domain.Module `json:"modules"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &independentPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(independentPayload.Modules) != 1 || independentPayload.Modules[0].ID != fixtures.independentModuleID {
		t.Fatalf("expected independent module %s, got %#v", fixtures.independentModuleID, independentPayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/module/list?tech_id=%d", apiPrefix, fixtures.mainTechID), "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public independent module list by tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &independentPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(independentPayload.Modules) != 1 || independentPayload.Modules[0].ID != fixtures.independentModuleID {
		t.Fatalf("expected independent module %s by tech, got %#v", fixtures.independentModuleID, independentPayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?tech_id=999", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public independent module list by unmatched tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &independentPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(independentPayload.Modules) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected no independent modules by unmatched tech, got %#v", independentPayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?course_id="+fixtures.courseID, "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public course module list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var coursePayload struct {
		Modules []domain.Module `json:"modules"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &coursePayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(coursePayload.Modules) != 1 || coursePayload.Modules[0].ID != fixtures.moduleID {
		t.Fatalf("expected course module %s, got %#v", fixtures.moduleID, coursePayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/module/list?course_id=%s&tech_id=%d", apiPrefix, fixtures.courseID, fixtures.mainTechID), "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public course module list by tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &coursePayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(coursePayload.Modules) != 1 || coursePayload.Modules[0].ID != fixtures.moduleID {
		t.Fatalf("expected course module %s by tech, got %#v", fixtures.moduleID, coursePayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?course_id="+fixtures.courseID+"&tech_id=999", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public course module list by unmatched tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &coursePayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(coursePayload.Modules) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected no course modules by unmatched tech, got %#v", coursePayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/section/list?module_id="+fixtures.moduleID, "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public module section list, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var sectionPayload struct {
		Sections []domain.Section `json:"sections"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &sectionPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(sectionPayload.Sections) != 1 || sectionPayload.Sections[0].ID != fixtures.sectionID {
		t.Fatalf("expected section %s, got %#v", fixtures.sectionID, sectionPayload.Sections)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/section/list", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("expected 422 for section list without module, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?scope=all", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("expected 422 for public all module scope, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?scope=all&tech_id=999", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("expected 422 for public all module scope with tech filter, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?tech_id=0", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("expected 400 for invalid module tech filter, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/module/list?tech_id=abc", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
		t.Fatalf("expected 400 for non-numeric module tech filter, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/module/list?scope=all", "", "ADMIN", "admin-user")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for admin all module scope, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var allPayload struct {
		Modules []domain.Module `json:"modules"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &allPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(allPayload.Modules) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 modules in all scope, got %#v", allPayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, fmt.Sprintf("%s/module/list?scope=content&tech_id=%d", adminPrefix, fixtures.mainTechID), "", "ADMIN", "admin-user")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for admin content module scope by tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &allPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(allPayload.Modules) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 content modules by tech, got %#v", allPayload.Modules)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/module/list?scope=content&tech_id=999", "", "ADMIN", "admin-user")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for admin content module scope by unmatched tech, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &allPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(allPayload.Modules) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected no content modules by unmatched tech, got %#v", allPayload.Modules)
	}
}

func TestModuleLessonsPublic(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/lesson/list?module_id="+fixtures.moduleID+"&fields=id,module_id,section_id,order,title", "", "", "")

	}

	var payload struct {
		Lessons []map[string]any `json:"lessons"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.Lessons) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 module lesson, got %#v", payload.Lessons)
	}
	if payload.Lessons[0]["id"] != fixtures.lessonID {

		t.Fatalf("expected section context %s, got %v", fixtures.sectionID, payload.Lessons[0]["section_id"])
	}
}

func TestLessonCanBeReusedAcrossSections(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	role := "ADMIN"
	userID := "admin-user"

	sectionBody := fmt.Sprintf(`{"tech_id":%d,"translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Reusable Section","description":"Reusable section desc"}]}`, fixtures.mainTechID, fixtures.i18nID)
	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/section/create", sectionBody, role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("expected 201 for section create, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var createdSection domain.Section
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &createdSection); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid section json: %v", err)
	}
	if createdSection.ID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected section id, got empty")
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, adminPrefix+"/section-relations/add-lesson/"+createdSection.ID, fmt.Sprintf(`{"lesson_id":"%s","order":5}`, fixtures.lessonID), role, userID)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("expected 204 for section lesson relation add, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	resp = performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/lesson/list?section_id="+createdSection.ID+"&fields=id,section_id,order,title", "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public section lessons, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var payload struct {
		Lessons []map[string]any `json:"lessons"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid lesson list json: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.Lessons) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 section lesson, got %#v", payload.Lessons)
	}
	if payload.Lessons[0]["id"] != fixtures.lessonID {
		t.Fatalf("expected reused lesson id %s, got %v", fixtures.lessonID, payload.Lessons[0]["id"])
	}
	if payload.Lessons[0]["section_id"] != createdSection.ID {
		t.Fatalf("expected section context %s, got %v", createdSection.ID, payload.Lessons[0]["section_id"])
	}
	if int(payload.Lessons[0]["order"].(float64)) != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("expected section lesson order 5, got %v", payload.Lessons[0]["order"])
	}
}

	var payload struct {
		Course struct {
			ID    string `json:"ID"`
			Title string `json:"title"`
		} `json:"course"`

		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	if payload.Course.ID != fixtures.courseID {
		t.Fatalf("expected course id %s, got %s", fixtures.courseID, payload.Course.ID)
	}
	if payload.Course.Title != "Existing Title" {
		t.Fatalf("expected title Existing Title, got %s", payload.Course.Title)
	}
}

func TestTaskComposeConfigFallback(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for task get, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

		ComposeConfig json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {

	}

	}
}

func TestTaskComposeConfigOverrideCanBeCleared(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	overrideBody := updateTaskBody(fixtures)

	resp := performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		overrideBody,
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 while setting task compose override, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}

	assertTaskComposeConfig(t, fixtures, `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/task-updated:latest"}}}`)
	if got := len(fixtures.composeConfigs.configs); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one compose config after first task override, got %d", got)
	}

	resp = performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		overrideBody,
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 while repeating task compose override, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if got := len(fixtures.composeConfigs.configs); got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected repeated override to reuse one compose config, got %d", got)
	}

	preserveBody := fmt.Sprintf(
		`{"title":"Task updated","description":"updated","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task updated","description":"updated"}],"code_structure":%s,"order":2,"status":1}`,
		fixtures.i18nID,
		taskCodeStructure(),
	)
	resp = performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		preserveBody,
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 while omitting task compose override, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	assertTaskComposeConfig(t, fixtures, `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/task-updated:latest"}}}`)

	clearBody := fmt.Sprintf(
		`{"title":"Task updated","description":"updated","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task updated","description":"updated"}],"code_structure":%s,"compose_config":null,"order":2,"status":1}`,
		fixtures.i18nID,
		taskCodeStructure(),
	)
	resp = performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		clearBody,
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 while clearing task compose override, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}

	assertTaskComposeConfig(t, fixtures, `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"fixture/lesson:latest"}}}`)
}

func TestTaskComposeConfigOverrideCannotBeClearedWithoutLessonRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	resp := performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		updateTaskBody(fixtures),
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 while setting task compose override, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}

	lesson := fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID]
	lesson.ComposeConfigID = nil
	lesson.ComposeConfig = nil
	fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID] = lesson

	clearBody := fmt.Sprintf(
		`{"title":"Task updated","description":"updated","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task updated","description":"updated"}],"code_structure":%s,"compose_config":null,"order":2,"status":1}`,
		fixtures.i18nID,
		taskCodeStructure(),
	)
	resp = performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/task/update/"+fixtures.taskID,
		clearBody,
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("expected 422 while clearing the only sandbox runtime, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	assertTaskComposeConfig(t, fixtures, `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/task-updated:latest"}}}`)
}

func TestSandboxTaskCannotBeCreatedWithoutTaskOrLessonRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tt := range []struct {
		name               string
		composeConfigField string
	}{
		{name: "omitted"},
		{name: "json null", composeConfigField: `,"compose_config":null`},
	} {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
			lesson := fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID]
			lesson.ComposeConfigID = nil
			lesson.ComposeConfig = nil
			fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID] = lesson

			body := fmt.Sprintf(
				`{"title":"Task","description":"desc","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task","description":"desc"}],"code_structure_type_id":"%s","code_structure":%s%s,"requires_sandbox":true,"order":2,"lesson_id":"%s"}`,
				fixtures.i18nID,
				fixtures.codeStructureTypeID,
				taskCodeStructure(),
				tt.composeConfigField,
				fixtures.lessonID,
			)
			resp := performRequest(
				fixtures.router,
				http.MethodPost,
				adminPrefix+"/task/create",
				body,
				"ADMIN",
				"runtime-admin",
			)
			if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
				t.Fatalf("expected 422 while creating a sandbox task without runtime, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
			if got := len(fixtures.tasks.tasks); got != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("expected rejected create not to persist a task, got %d tasks", got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLessonRuntimeCannotBeClearedWhileSandboxTaskInheritsIt(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	updateBody := func(composeConfigField string) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf(
			`{"title":"Lesson","excerpt":"excerpt","description":"desc","versions":[{"tech_version_id":%d}]%s,"status":1}`,
			fixtures.techVersionID,
			composeConfigField,
		)
	}

	resp := performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/lesson/update/"+fixtures.lessonID,
		updateBody(""),
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected omitted lesson runtime to be preserved, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if got := string(fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID].ComposeConfig); got != `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"fixture/lesson:latest"}}}` {
		t.Fatalf("expected omitted lesson runtime to remain unchanged, got %s", got)
	}

	resp = performRequest(
		fixtures.router,
		http.MethodPut,
		adminPrefix+"/lesson/update/"+fixtures.lessonID,
		updateBody(`,"compose_config":null`),
		"ADMIN",
		"runtime-admin",
	)
	if resp.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		t.Fatalf("expected 422 while clearing an inherited lesson runtime, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
	}
	if got := string(fixtures.lessons.lessons[fixtures.lessonID].ComposeConfig); got != `{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"fixture/lesson:latest"}}}` {
		t.Fatalf("expected rejected lesson clear to preserve runtime, got %s", got)
	}
}

func TestManifestReorderAcceptsTemporaryRelationOrders(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		path string
		body string
	}{
		{
			name: "course module",
			path: adminPrefix + "/course-relations/add-module/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"module_id":"%s","order":-32768}`, fixtures.moduleID),
		},
		{
			name: "module section",
			path: adminPrefix + "/module-relations/add-section/" + fixtures.moduleID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"section_id":"%s","order":-32768}`, fixtures.sectionID),
		},
		{
			name: "section lesson",
			path: adminPrefix + "/section-relations/add-lesson/" + fixtures.sectionID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"lesson_id":"%s","order":-32768}`, fixtures.lessonID),
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPost, tt.path, tt.body, "ADMIN", "manifest-importer")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
				t.Fatalf("expected 204 for temporary reorder, got %d: %s", resp.Code, resp.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestManifestReplaceHierarchyRelations(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		path string
		body string
	}{
		{
			name: "course modules",
			path: adminPrefix + "/course-relations/replace-modules/" + fixtures.courseID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"items":[{"id":"%s","order":11}]}`, fixtures.moduleID),
		},
		{
			name: "module sections",
			path: adminPrefix + "/module-relations/replace-sections/" + fixtures.moduleID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"items":[{"id":"%s","order":13}]}`, fixtures.sectionID),
		},
		{
			name: "section lessons",
			path: adminPrefix + "/section-relations/replace-lessons/" + fixtures.sectionID,
			body: fmt.Sprintf(`{"items":[{"id":"%s","order":17}]}`, fixtures.lessonID),
		},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			response := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodPut, test.path, test.body, "ADMIN", "manifest-importer")
			if response.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
				t.Fatalf("expected 204, got %d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	if got := fixtures.sectionLessons.placements[fixtures.sectionID][fixtures.lessonID]; got != 17 {
		t.Fatalf("section lesson order=%d, want 17", got)
	}
}

func assertTaskComposeConfig(t *testing.T, fixtures routerFixtures, expected string) {
	t.Helper()
	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/task/get/"+fixtures.taskID, "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for task get, got %d", resp.Code)
	}
	var payload struct {
		ComposeConfig json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid task json: %v", err)
	}
	if string(payload.ComposeConfig) != expected {
		t.Fatalf("expected compose_config %s, got %s", expected, string(payload.ComposeConfig))
	}
}

func TestCourseAccessByRole(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		method string
		path   string
	}{
		{name: "list courses", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/course/list"},
		{name: "get course", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/course/get-by-slug/existing-course"},
		{name: "get course by id", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/course/get/" + fixtures.courseID},
		{name: "list lessons by course", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/lesson/list?course_id=" + fixtures.courseID},
		{name: "get lesson", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/lesson/get/" + fixtures.lessonID},
		{name: "list tasks", method: http.MethodGet, path: apiPrefix + "/task/list?lesson_id=" + fixtures.lessonID},
	}
	roles := []string{"ADMIN", "MANAGE", "MODERATOR", "TEACHER", "STUDENT", "GUEST", ""}
	for _, route := range cases {
		t.Run(route.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			for _, role := range roles {
				resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, route.method, route.path, "", role, "user")
				if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
					t.Fatalf("expected 200 for role %q on %s %s, got %d", role, route.method, route.path, resp.Code)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAdminGetLesson(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	allowedRoles := []string{"ADMIN", "MODERATOR", "TEACHER"}
	for _, role := range allowedRoles {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("get lesson as %s", role), func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/lesson/get/"+fixtures.lessonID, "", role, "user-allowed")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("expected 200 for role %s on GET /lesson/get/%s, got %d", role, fixtures.lessonID, resp.Code)
			}

			var payload map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
			}
			id, ok := payload["id"].(string)
			if !ok || id != fixtures.lessonID {
				t.Fatalf("expected lesson id %s, got %v", fixtures.lessonID, payload["id"])
			}
		})
	}

	forbiddenRoles := []string{"STUDENT", "GUEST"}
	for _, role := range forbiddenRoles {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("get lesson forbidden for %s", role), func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/lesson/get/"+fixtures.lessonID, "", role, "user-forbidden")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
				t.Fatalf("expected 403 for role %s on GET /lesson/get/%s, got %d", role, fixtures.lessonID, resp.Code)
			}
		})
	}

	t.Run("get lesson guest unauthorized", func(t *testing.T) {
		resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/lesson/get/"+fixtures.lessonID, "", "", "")
		if resp.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
			t.Fatalf("expected 401 for guest on GET /lesson/get/%s, got %d", fixtures.lessonID, resp.Code)
		}
	})
}

func TestAdminGetTask(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	allowedRoles := []string{"ADMIN", "MODERATOR", "TEACHER"}
	for _, role := range allowedRoles {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("get task as %s", role), func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/task/get/"+fixtures.taskID, "", role, "user-allowed")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
				t.Fatalf("expected 200 for role %s on GET /task/get/%s, got %d", role, fixtures.taskID, resp.Code)
			}

			var payload map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
			}
			id, ok := payload["id"].(string)
			if !ok || id != fixtures.taskID {
				t.Fatalf("expected task id %s, got %v", fixtures.taskID, payload["id"])
			}
		})
	}

	forbiddenRoles := []string{"STUDENT", "GUEST"}
	for _, role := range forbiddenRoles {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("get task forbidden for %s", role), func(t *testing.T) {
			resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/task/get/"+fixtures.taskID, "", role, "user-forbidden")
			if resp.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
				t.Fatalf("expected 403 for role %s on GET /task/get/%s, got %d", role, fixtures.taskID, resp.Code)
			}
		})
	}

	t.Run("get task guest unauthorized", func(t *testing.T) {
		resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, adminPrefix+"/task/get/"+fixtures.taskID, "", "", "")
		if resp.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
			t.Fatalf("expected 401 for guest on GET /task/get/%s, got %d", fixtures.taskID, resp.Code)
		}
	})
}

func TestPublicGetLesson(t *testing.T) {
	fixtures := newRouterFixtures(t)

	resp := performRequest(fixtures.router, http.MethodGet, apiPrefix+"/lesson/get/"+fixtures.lessonID, "", "", "")
	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("expected 200 for public lesson get, got %d", resp.Code)
	}

	var payload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("invalid json: %v", err)
	}
	id, ok := payload["id"].(string)
	if !ok || id != fixtures.lessonID {
		t.Fatalf("expected lesson id %s, got %v", fixtures.lessonID, payload["id"])
	}
}

func createTaskBody(fixtures routerFixtures, lessonID string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Task","description":"desc","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task","description":"desc"}],"code_structure_type_id":"%s","code_structure":%s,"compose_config":{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/task:latest"}}},"order":1,"lesson_id":"%s"}`,
		fixtures.i18nID,
		fixtures.codeStructureTypeID,
		taskCodeStructure(),
		lessonID,
	)
}

func updateTaskBody(fixtures routerFixtures) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Task updated","description":"updated","translations":[{"i18n_id":%d,"title":"Task updated","description":"updated"}],"code_structure":%s,"compose_config":{"version":"3.9","services":{"app":{"image":"auth/task-updated:latest"}}},"order":2,"status":1}`,
		fixtures.i18nID,
		taskCodeStructure(),
	)
}

func taskCodeStructure() string {
	return `{"version":1,"kind":"workspace_contract","workspace":{"required_files":["main.go"]},"stages":[{"id":"source","engine":"ts.ast","targets":{"files":["main.go"]}}],"links":[]}`
}

func performRequest(router http.Handler, method, path, body, role, userID string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	req := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if userID != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", userID)
	}
	if role != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", role)
	}
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)
	return resp
}

	courses  map[string]domain.Course
	previews []domain.CoursePreview
}

func (integrationAllowAllContentAccess) CanViewCourse(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}
func (integrationAllowAllContentAccess) CanViewModule(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}

	return true, nil
}

	return true, nil
}
func (integrationAllowAllContentAccess) CanViewTask(context.Context, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}

	return true, nil
}

	return true, nil
}
func (integrationAllowAllContentAccess) CanViewTaskViaRelation(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return true, nil

	return true, nil
}

func newFakeCourseRepository() *fakeCourseRepository {
	return &fakeCourseRepository{courses: map[string]domain.Course{}, previews: []domain.CoursePreview{}}
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, course domain.Course) error {
	r.courses[course.ID] = course
	r.previews = append(r.previews, domain.CoursePreview{ID: course.ID, Slug: course.Slug, Title: course.Slug, Description: ""})
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) GetBySlug(_ repository.Context, slug string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	for _, c := range r.courses {
		if c.Slug == slug {
			copy := c
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) GetByID(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	course, ok := r.courses[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := course
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) GetByIDWithFields(_ repository.Context, id string, _ queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	course, ok := r.courses[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return map[string]any{
		"id":           course.ID,
		"slug":         course.Slug,
		"title":        "Existing Title",
		"description":  "Existing Description",
		"tags":         []any{},
		"lesson_count": 1,
		"techs":        []any{},
	}, nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, course domain.Course) error {
	if _, ok := r.courses[course.ID]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	r.courses[course.ID] = course
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, courseID string) error {
	delete(r.courses, courseID)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) List(_ repository.Context, _ string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters, _ *filters.SortOptions) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error) {
	result := make([]domain.CoursePreview, 0, len(r.previews))
	for _, preview := range r.previews {
		if !r.matchesFilters(preview, courseFilters) {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, preview)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) ListFields(_ repository.Context, _ string, _ queryfields.Set, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters, _ *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(r.previews))
	for _, preview := range r.previews {
		if !r.matchesFilters(preview, courseFilters) {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"id":          preview.ID,
			"slug":        preview.Slug,
			"title":       preview.Title,
			"description": preview.Description,
		})
	}
	return result, len(result), nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseRepository) matchesFilters(preview domain.CoursePreview, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters) bool {
	if courseFilters.ID != nil && preview.ID != *courseFilters.ID {
		return false
	}
	if courseFilters.Slug != nil && preview.Slug != *courseFilters.Slug {
		return false
	}
	if courseFilters.Status != nil {
		course, ok := r.courses[preview.ID]
		if !ok || course.Status != *courseFilters.Status {
			return false
		}
	}
	if courseFilters.Title != nil && !containsIgnoreCase(preview.Title, *courseFilters.Title) {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func containsIgnoreCase(s, substr string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(s), strings.ToLower(substr))
}

type fakeCourseI18nRepository struct {
	items []domain.CourseI18n
}

func newFakeCourseI18nRepository() *fakeCourseI18nRepository {
	return &fakeCourseI18nRepository{items: []domain.CourseI18n{}}
}

func (r *fakeCourseI18nRepository) Upsert(_ repository.Context, entry domain.CourseI18n) error {
	for idx, item := range r.items {
		if item.CourseID == entry.CourseID && item.I18nID == entry.I18nID {
			r.items[idx] = entry
			return nil
		}
	}
	r.items = append(r.items, entry)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseI18nRepository) GetByCourseAndLang(_ repository.Context, courseID string, _ string) (*domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	for _, item := range r.items {
		if item.CourseID == courseID {
			copy := item
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (r *fakeCourseI18nRepository) ListByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.CourseI18n, error) {
	result := []domain.CourseI18n{}
	for _, item := range r.items {
		if item.CourseID == courseID {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseI18nRepository) CountByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string) (int, error) {
	items, _ := r.ListByCourse(context.Background(), courseID)
	return len(items), nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseI18nRepository) DeleteByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string, i18nID int) error {
	for idx, item := range r.items {
		if item.CourseID == courseID && item.I18nID == i18nID {
			r.items = append(r.items[:idx], r.items[idx+1:]...)
			return nil
		}
	}
	return domain.ErrNotFound
}

type fakeModuleRepository struct {
	modules map[string]domain.Module
	links   *fakeCourseModuleRepository
}

func newFakeModuleRepository(links *fakeCourseModuleRepository) *fakeModuleRepository {
	return &fakeModuleRepository{modules: map[string]domain.Module{}, links: links}
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, module domain.Module) error {
	r.modules[module.ID] = module
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) Get(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.Module, error) {
	module, ok := r.modules[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := module
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, module domain.Module) error {
	if _, ok := r.modules[module.ID]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	r.modules[module.ID] = module
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, id string) error {
	module, ok := r.modules[id]
	if !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	module.Status = domain.ModuleStatusNoActive
	r.modules[id] = module
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) List(_ repository.Context, filter filters.ModuleFilters) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	var result []domain.Module
	switch {
	case filter.CourseID != "":
		result, _ = r.ListByCourse(context.Background(), filter.CourseID)
	case filter.Scope == "independent" || filter.Scope == "standalone":
		result, _ = r.ListIndependent(context.Background())
	case filter.Scope == "" || filter.Scope == "all" || filter.Scope == "content" || filter.Scope == "course_only" || filter.Scope == "both" || filter.Scope == "internal":
		result, _ = r.ListAll(context.Background())
		result = filterFakeModulesByScope(result, filter.Scope)
	default:
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	filtered := make([]domain.Module, 0, len(result))
	for _, module := range result {
		if filter.TechID != nil && (module.TechID == nil || *module.TechID != *filter.TechID) {
			continue
		}
		if filter.ActiveOnly && module.Status != domain.ModuleStatusActive {
			continue
		}
		filtered = append(filtered, module)
	}
	return filtered, nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) ListAll(_ repository.Context) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	result := make([]domain.Module, 0, len(r.modules))
	for _, module := range r.modules {
		result = append(result, module)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) ListIndependent(_ repository.Context) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	result := make([]domain.Module, 0, len(r.modules))
	for _, module := range r.modules {
		if module.Visibility == domain.ModuleVisibilityStandalone || module.Visibility == domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth {
			result = append(result, module)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (r *fakeModuleRepository) ListByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	ids := r.links.moduleIDs(courseID)
	result := make([]domain.Module, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		if module, ok := r.modules[id]; ok {
			result = append(result, module)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func filterFakeModulesByScope(items []domain.Module, scope string) []domain.Module {
	if scope == "" || scope == "all" {
		return items
	}
	result := make([]domain.Module, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		switch scope {
		case "content":
			if item.Visibility != domain.ModuleVisibilityInternal {
				result = append(result, item)
			}
		case "course_only":
			if item.Visibility == domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly {
				result = append(result, item)
			}
		case "both":
			if item.Visibility == domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth {
				result = append(result, item)
			}
		case "internal":
			if item.Visibility == domain.ModuleVisibilityInternal {
				result = append(result, item)
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}

type fakeCourseModuleRepository struct {
	links map[string][]string
}

func newFakeCourseModuleRepository() *fakeCourseModuleRepository {
	return &fakeCourseModuleRepository{links: map[string][]string{}}
}

func (r *fakeCourseModuleRepository) ReplaceByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	r.links[courseID] = nil
	for _, item := range items {
		r.links[courseID] = append(r.links[courseID], item.ChildID)
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseModuleRepository) Add(_ repository.Context, courseID string, moduleID string, _ int) error {
	for _, existing := range r.links[courseID] {
		if existing == moduleID {
			return nil
		}
	}
	r.links[courseID] = append(r.links[courseID], moduleID)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseModuleRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, courseID string, moduleID string) error {
	items := r.links[courseID]
	for idx, existing := range items {
		if existing == moduleID {
			r.links[courseID] = append(items[:idx], items[idx+1:]...)
			return nil
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCourseModuleRepository) moduleIDs(courseID string) []string {
	return append([]string(nil), r.links[courseID]...)
}

func (r *fakeCourseModuleRepository) courseIDForModule(moduleID string) string {
	for courseID, modules := range r.links {
		for _, current := range modules {
			if current == moduleID {
				return courseID
			}
		}
	}
	return ""
}

type fakeTechRepository struct {
	techs map[int]domain.Tech
}

func newFakeTechRepository() *fakeTechRepository {
	return &fakeTechRepository{techs: map[int]domain.Tech{}}
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, tech domain.Tech) error {
	r.techs[tech.ID] = tech
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) GetByLabel(_ repository.Context, label string) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	for _, t := range r.techs {
		if t.Label == label {
			copy := t
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) GetByID(_ repository.Context, id int) (*domain.Tech, error) {
	tech, ok := r.techs[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := tech
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, tech domain.Tech) error {
	if _, ok := r.techs[tech.ID]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	r.techs[tech.ID] = tech
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, id int) error {
	if _, ok := r.techs[id]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	delete(r.techs, id)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTechRepository) List(_ repository.Context, filter filters.TechFilters) ([]domain.Tech, int, error) {
	items := make([]domain.Tech, 0, len(r.techs))
	for _, t := range r.techs {
		if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(t.Label), strings.ToLower(*filter.Query)) {
			continue
		}
		items = append(items, t)
	}
	sort.Slice(items, func(i, j int) bool { return items[i].Label < items[j].Label })
	return items, len(items), nil
}

type fakeSectionLessonRepository struct {
	placements map[string]map[string]int
}

func newFakeSectionLessonRepository() *fakeSectionLessonRepository {
	return &fakeSectionLessonRepository{placements: map[string]map[string]int{}}
}

func (r *fakeSectionLessonRepository) ReplaceBySection(_ repository.Context, sectionID string, items []domain.CatalogRelationOrder) error {
	r.placements[sectionID] = map[string]int{}
	for _, item := range items {
		r.placements[sectionID][item.ChildID] = item.Order
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeSectionLessonRepository) Add(_ repository.Context, sectionID string, lessonID string, order int) error {
	if r.placements[sectionID] == nil {
		r.placements[sectionID] = map[string]int{}
	}
	r.placements[sectionID][lessonID] = order
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeSectionLessonRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, sectionID string, lessonID string) error {
	if r.placements[sectionID] != nil {
		delete(r.placements[sectionID], lessonID)
	}
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeSectionLessonRepository) firstPlacement(lessonID string) (string, int) {
	for sectionID, lessons := range r.placements {
		if order, ok := lessons[lessonID]; ok {
			return sectionID, order
		}
	}
	return "", 0
}

type fakeLessonRepository struct {
	lessons        map[string]domain.Lesson
	sections       *fakeSectionRepository
	moduleSections *fakeModuleSectionRepository
	courseModules  *fakeCourseModuleRepository
	sectionLessons *fakeSectionLessonRepository
}

func newFakeLessonRepository(sections *fakeSectionRepository, moduleSections *fakeModuleSectionRepository, courseModules *fakeCourseModuleRepository, sectionLessons *fakeSectionLessonRepository) *fakeLessonRepository {
	return &fakeLessonRepository{
		lessons:        map[string]domain.Lesson{},
		sections:       sections,
		moduleSections: moduleSections,
		courseModules:  courseModules,
		sectionLessons: sectionLessons,
	}
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error {
	r.lessons[lesson.ID] = lesson
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) Get(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	lesson, ok := r.lessons[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := r.withFirstPlacement(lesson)
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) GetWithFields(_ repository.Context, id string, _ queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	lesson, ok := r.lessons[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	lesson = r.withFirstPlacement(lesson)
	return map[string]any{
		"id":          lesson.ID,
		"section_id":  lesson.SectionID,
		"module_id":   lesson.ModuleID,
		"course_id":   lesson.CourseID,
		"title":       lesson.Title,
		"excerpt":     lesson.Excerpt,
		"description": lesson.Description,
		"order":       lesson.Order,
		"status":      lesson.Status,
		"versions":    lesson.Versions,
	}, nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, lesson domain.Lesson) error {
	existing, ok := r.lessons[lesson.ID]
	if ok && lesson.SectionID == "" {
		lesson.SectionID = existing.SectionID
	}
	if ok && lesson.CourseID == "" {
		lesson.CourseID = existing.CourseID
	}
	if ok && lesson.Order == 0 {
		lesson.Order = existing.Order
	}
	r.lessons[lesson.ID] = lesson
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, lessonID string) error {
	delete(r.lessons, lessonID)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) ListByCourse(_ repository.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	var list []domain.Lesson
	for sectionID, lessons := range r.sectionLessons.placements {
		if r.courseIDForSection(sectionID) != courseID {
			continue
		}
		for lessonID, order := range lessons {
			lesson, ok := r.lessons[lessonID]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			lesson.SectionID = sectionID
			lesson.ModuleID = r.moduleIDForSection(sectionID)
			lesson.CourseID = courseID
			lesson.Order = order
			list = append(list, lesson)
		}
	}
	return list, nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) ListByCourseFields(_ repository.Context, courseID string, _ queryfields.Set, lessonFilters filters.LessonFilters, _ *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	var lessons []domain.Lesson
	if courseID != "" {
		lessons, _ = r.ListByCourse(context.Background(), courseID)
	} else if lessonFilters.CourseID != nil {
		lessons, _ = r.ListByCourse(context.Background(), *lessonFilters.CourseID)
	} else if lessonFilters.ModuleID != nil {
		for _, sectionID := range r.moduleSections.sectionIDs(*lessonFilters.ModuleID) {
			sectionLessons, _ := r.ListBySection(context.Background(), sectionID)
			lessons = append(lessons, sectionLessons...)
		}
	} else if lessonFilters.SectionID != nil {
		lessons, _ = r.ListBySection(context.Background(), *lessonFilters.SectionID)
	} else {
		for sectionID := range r.sectionLessons.placements {
			sectionLessons, _ := r.ListBySection(context.Background(), sectionID)
			lessons = append(lessons, sectionLessons...)
		}
	}
	var result []map[string]any
	for _, lesson := range lessons {
		if lessonFilters.SectionID != nil && lesson.SectionID != *lessonFilters.SectionID {
			continue
		}
		if lessonFilters.ModuleID != nil && lesson.ModuleID != *lessonFilters.ModuleID {
			continue
		}
		if lessonFilters.Status != nil && lesson.Status != *lessonFilters.Status {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"id":          lesson.ID,
			"course_id":   lesson.CourseID,
			"section_id":  lesson.SectionID,
			"module_id":   lesson.ModuleID,
			"title":       lesson.Title,
			"excerpt":     lesson.Excerpt,
			"description": lesson.Description,
			"order":       lesson.Order,
			"status":      lesson.Status,
			"versions":    lesson.Versions,
			"created_at":  lesson.CreatedAt,
			"updated_at":  lesson.UpdatedAt,
		})
	}
	return result, len(result), nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) ListBySection(_ repository.Context, sectionID string) ([]domain.Lesson, error) {
	var list []domain.Lesson
	for lessonID, order := range r.sectionLessons.placements[sectionID] {
		lesson, ok := r.lessons[lessonID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		lesson.SectionID = sectionID
		lesson.ModuleID = r.moduleIDForSection(sectionID)
		lesson.CourseID = r.courseIDForSection(sectionID)
		lesson.Order = order
		list = append(list, lesson)
	}
	return list, nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) withFirstPlacement(lesson domain.Lesson) domain.Lesson {
	if lesson.SectionID == "" {
		sectionID, order := r.sectionLessons.firstPlacement(lesson.ID)
		lesson.SectionID = sectionID
		lesson.Order = order
	}
	if lesson.CourseID == "" {
		lesson.CourseID = r.courseIDForSection(lesson.SectionID)
	}
	if lesson.ModuleID == "" {
		lesson.ModuleID = r.moduleIDForSection(lesson.SectionID)
	}
	return lesson
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) moduleIDForSection(sectionID string) string {
	return r.moduleSections.moduleIDForSection(sectionID)
}

func (r *fakeLessonRepository) courseIDForSection(sectionID string) string {
	moduleID := r.moduleSections.moduleIDForSection(sectionID)
	if moduleID == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return r.courseModules.courseIDForModule(moduleID)
}

type fakeLessonVersionRepository struct {
	items map[string][]domain.LessonVersion
}

func newFakeLessonVersionRepository() *fakeLessonVersionRepository {
	return &fakeLessonVersionRepository{items: map[string][]domain.LessonVersion{}}
}

func (r *fakeLessonVersionRepository) ReplaceByLesson(_ repository.Context, lessonID string, versions []domain.LessonVersion) error {
	result := make([]domain.LessonVersion, 0, len(versions))
	for _, version := range versions {
		version.LessonID = lessonID
		result = append(result, version)
	}
	r.items[lessonID] = result
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonVersionRepository) ListByLesson(_ repository.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonVersion, error) {
	return append([]domain.LessonVersion(nil), r.items[lessonID]...), nil
}

type fakeLessonI18nRepository struct {
	items []domain.LessonI18n
}

func newFakeLessonI18nRepository() *fakeLessonI18nRepository {
	return &fakeLessonI18nRepository{items: []domain.LessonI18n{}}
}

func (r *fakeLessonI18nRepository) Upsert(_ repository.Context, entry domain.LessonI18n) error {
	r.items = append(r.items, entry)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeLessonI18nRepository) ListByLesson(_ repository.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonI18n, error) {
	var result []domain.LessonI18n
	for _, item := range r.items {
		if item.LessonID == lessonID {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

type fakeTaskRepository struct {
	tasks   map[string]domain.Task
	lessons *fakeLessonRepository
}

func newFakeTaskRepository(lessons *fakeLessonRepository) *fakeTaskRepository {
	return &fakeTaskRepository{tasks: map[string]domain.Task{}, lessons: lessons}
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, task domain.Task) error {
	r.tasks[task.ID] = task
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, task domain.Task) error {
	r.tasks[task.ID] = task
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, taskID string) error {
	delete(r.tasks, taskID)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) Get(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	task, ok := r.tasks[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := r.withComposeFallback(task)
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) GetWithFields(_ repository.Context, id string, _ queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	task, ok := r.tasks[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return map[string]any{"id": task.ID, "title": task.Title}, nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) ListByLesson(_ repository.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	var list []domain.Task
	for _, task := range r.tasks {
		if task.LessonID == lessonID {
			list = append(list, r.withComposeFallback(task))
		}
	}
	return list, nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) ListByLessonFields(_ repository.Context, lessonID string, _ queryfields.Set, _ filters.TaskFilters, _ *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	tasks, _ := r.ListByLesson(context.Background(), lessonID)
	result := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(tasks))
	for _, task := range tasks {
		result = append(result, map[string]any{
			"id":                     task.ID,
			"lesson_id":              task.LessonID,
			"title":                  task.Title,
			"description":            task.Description,
			"code_structure_type_id": task.CodeStructureTypeID,
			"code_structure":         task.CodeStructure,
			"compose_config":         task.ResolvedComposeConfig,
			"order":                  task.Order,
			"status":                 task.Status,
			"version":                task.Version,
		})
	}
	return result, len(result), nil
}

func (r *fakeTaskRepository) withComposeFallback(task domain.Task) domain.Task {
	if task.ComposeConfig != nil {
		task.ResolvedComposeConfig = task.ComposeConfig
		return task
	}
	if r.lessons != nil {
		if lesson, ok := r.lessons.lessons[task.LessonID]; ok && lesson.ComposeConfig != nil {
			task.ResolvedComposeConfig = lesson.ComposeConfig
		}
	}
	return task
}

type fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository struct {
	structures map[string]domain.CodeStructureType
}

func newFakeCodeStructureTypeRepository() *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository {
	return &fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository{structures: map[string]domain.CodeStructureType{}}
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) Create(_ repository.Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error {
	r.structures[structureType.ID] = structureType
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) Update(_ repository.Context, structureType domain.CodeStructureType) error {
	if _, ok := r.structures[structureType.ID]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	r.structures[structureType.ID] = structureType
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) Delete(_ repository.Context, id string) error {
	if _, ok := r.structures[id]; !ok {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	delete(r.structures, id)
	return nil
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) Get(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	return r.GetByID(context.Background(), id)
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) GetByID(_ repository.Context, id string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	structure, ok := r.structures[id]
	if !ok {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := structure
	return &copy, nil
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) GetByCode(_ repository.Context, code string) (*domain.CodeStructureType, error) {
	for _, structure := range r.structures {
		if structure.Code == code {
			copy := structure
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (r *fakeCodeStructureTypeRepository) List(_ repository.Context, _ filters.CodeStructureTypeFilters) ([]domain.CodeStructureType, int, error) {
	result := make([]domain.CodeStructureType, 0, len(r.structures))
	for _, structure := range r.structures {
		result = append(result, structure)
	}
	return result, len(result), nil
}

type fakeTxManager struct{}

func (fakeTxManager) WithTx(ctx repository.Context, fn func(ctx repository.Context) error) error {
	return fn(ctx)
}

type nopPublisher struct{}

func (nopPublisher) Publish(context.Context, string, any) error { return nil }
